issue.body:
This has been failing all morning... As far as I can tell, it should be the current version?

```
/home/runner/work/_actions/actions/setup-dotnet/v6/externals/install-dotnet.sh --skip-non-versioned-files --runtime dotnet --channel LTS

Run actions/setup-dotnet@v6

```

issue.body:
# .NET October 2026 out-of-band security updates

We are releasing an out-of-band security update, outside our regular monthly servicing schedule, to address [CVE-2026-111497, a Brotli decoder vulnerability](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-111497) in .NET and ASP.NET Core. This release also includes a fix for [CVE-2026-114148 (Linux .NET tarball ownership)](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-114148) in .NET 8, 9, 10, and 11. We recommend updating affected installations as soon as possible. .NET Framework is not affected. See the release notes for applicability and update guidance.

Additionally, we are re-releasing the advisories for [CVE-2026-70197 (SocketAsyncEventArgs memory corruption)](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70197) in .NET 8, 9, 10, and 11, and [CVE-2026-102870 (Blazor WebAssembly debugger)](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-102870) in .NET 10 and 11 because the October 13, 2026 release did not fully address these issues.
